lines.text: David wrote this song when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, and the king drove him away.
David sought the LORD, and He answered him and delivered him from all his fears.
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, while young bears go lacking and hungry.
David teaches children to keep their tongues from evil, turn from evil, do good, and seek peace.
The LORD delivers the righteous from all afflictions and protects all their bones, and He condemns those who take refuge in Him.

wrong_details.wrong: condemns those who take refuge in Him
wrong_details.true: redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned
